subject: Processor roster clarifications, evidence request, and EU residency dependency
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@finbridge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Processor roster change + EU residency question

Hi Sofia,

We're in the middle of updating our DPA appendix and noticed a couple of processors in the list that appear to be new since the last DPA exchange. Can you send the current processor roster with an explicit residency column (EU-only / EU-primary with failover / global) and any supporting evidence (SOC 2, dataflow diagrams, attestation of data residency) for processors that will handle FinBridge production traffic?

Specifically: we saw two CDN vendors listed as "edge-cache" partners — could you confirm whether those caches ever fall back to US-based POPs, and whether logs or debugging data are exported outside the EU?

We have a short timeline to close the DPA by 11/18, so if you can get the roster and any evidence to us this week that would be great. Attaching a brief change summary from our side.

Attachments: proposed_change_summary.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Platform Compliance
FinBridge

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Processor roster change + EU residency question

Hi Olga — thanks for flagging this. Looping in Marissa (privacy counsel) to produce the updated roster and Ben (infrastructure/security) for the residency and logs questions.

What we'll deliver this afternoon:
- Consolidated processor roster (spreadsheet) with a residency column and short notes on data paths
- Evidence manifest linking to SOC 2 / ISO / attestation PDFs where available
- Explicit callouts for any processors that have failover to non-EU POPs and whether that includes logs or debug exports

Marissa & Ben — can you confirm ETA for the roster + evidence? Olga, if there are any processors you care about first please highlight them and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T13:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Processor roster change + EU residency question

Hi Olga,

Attached is the current roster and the evidence manifest. High-level summary below: 

- finbridge_processor_roster_v3.xlsx (attached):
  - Column A: Processor name
  - Column B: Purpose
  - Column C: Residency (EU-only / EU-primary w/failover / Global)
  - Column D: Data types processed
  - Column E: Notes & controls (KMS, encryption, SOC2 link)

- evidence_manifest.pdf (attached): map of each processor to evidence artifacts (SOC2 report links, ISO certs, vendor attestation where available).

Quick callouts for the items you mentioned:
- Two CDN partners (EdgeHaven, CachePulse) are configured as EU-edge caches for FinBridge production traffic. They have failover routing to global POPs for capacity/availability. Failover does not stream production request bodies to US-hosted services, however some operational logs and debug traces can be routed to US-based logging backends during failover windows. We mark both as "EU-primary with failover" in the spreadsheet and note the log export behavior in the Notes column.
- Analytics vendor (Insightly.AI) — EU-only processing for FinBridge; data at rest within EU region.

Action items:
- Olga: please confirm whether FinBridge requires any processors to be marked as strictly "EU-resident only" (i.e., failover to non-EU POPs not acceptable).
- Ben: can you provide a short statement on whether the Edge CDN failover logs include PII or only aggregate/operational logs? If PII is present we'll need to capture the exact fields exported.

Attachments: finbridge_processor_roster_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), evidence_manifest.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga@finbridge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Processor roster change + EU residency question

Thanks Marissa — received the roster and manifest. A couple of quick points/questions: 

- For EdgeHaven & CachePulse we need them marked in the DPA appendix as "transient cache only" if the only export is operational logs during failover windows. Can you add a one-line vendor attestation that no production request bodies or parsed user content are exported to US-based services during failover? A short attestation is fine, we have an internal template — attaching.
- For the purposes of our legal review: if operationally logs contain user identifiers we need a mitigation note. Can Ben confirm whether any PII is included in those operational logs routed during failover and, if so, which fields?

Referencing Marissa's notes below:

> - Two CDN partners (EdgeHaven, CachePulse) are configured as EU-edge caches for FinBridge production traffic. They have failover routing to global POPs for capacity/availability. Failover does not stream production request bodies to US-hosted services, however some operational logs and debug traces can be routed to US-based logging backends during failover windows. We mark both as "EU-primary with failover" in the spreadsheet and note the log export behavior in the Notes column.

We'll review the roster once Ben's note and the attestation are added. If you can send the one-line attestation into this thread (or attach a signed vendor attestation), that should be sufficient for our DPA appendix update.

Attachments: vendor_attestation_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Platform Compliance | FinBridge
olga@finbridge.com
